limits: Full module scope, not diff-only. Six material survivors are caught in the expanded integration cohort; one allocation-hint survivor is excluded from functional interpretation. Timeouts and unviable builds are separate from failing-test catches. Modules, frontend orchestration/CSS, main, benchmark and test harnesses outside the listed scopes are not mutated.
